name: Persistent x86 (Px86)
description: First formalisation of the persistency semantics of the Intel-x86 architecture, layering a persist-order axiom (what survives a crash on non-volatile memory) on top of the x86 (x86-TSO) consistency model. Given both operationally and declaratively, with the two shown equivalent. The persist dimension is orthogonal to x86's store-load reordering; the crash-free behaviour coincides with x86-TSO.

catSupport.note: A declarative persist-order axiom layered on x86-TSO; per-execution and cat-shaped, but herd7 has no persistency events.
